summary: Iter 216h23 (All Sites + Sidebar Restructure) - 7/7 backend tests PASSED, frontend visual verification PASSED. New GET /api/master-admin/all-sites endpoint works correctly with auth gating, Pulse scope filtering (brand='pulse'), and query params (org_id, site_type, q, limit). Frontend AdminAllSites component renders correctly with totals strip (32 sites, 17 HQs, 15 branches), filter bar (search, type, org dropdowns), and sites table. Sidebar restructure verified: 'Sites' standalone entry REMOVED, 'Catalogue & Library' entry EXISTS, 'All sites' sub-tab under Organisations EXISTS.

test_2_all_sites_gymaxis_admin.details: GymAxis Master Admin gets all sites with brand='all'. Response includes sites[], totals{sites,head_offices,branches,equipment}, brand. Verified 32 sites, 17 head offices, 15 branches.

test_3_all_sites_query_params.details: Query params work correctly: site_type=head_office returns only HQs, site_type=branch returns only branches. Limit param respected.

test_4_pulse_admin_scope.details: Pulse Master Admin (pulse.scope.test@pulsefitness.com) gets brand='pulse' and filtered sites. Pulse admin sees same or fewer sites than GymAxis admin, confirming scope filtering.

test_5_sidebar_restructure.details: Sidebar verified via screenshot: 'Organisations' group visible with sub-tabs (List, All sites, Customer onboarding, Module subscriptions, Customer activation). 'Catalogue & Library' entry visible. Standalone 'Sites' entry REMOVED.

test_6_admin_all_sites_component.details: AdminAllSites component renders at section=all-sites with data-testid=admin-all-sites. Totals strip (data-testid=admin-all-sites-totals) shows 4 tiles. Filter bar has search, type filter, org filter, result count. Table (data-testid=admin-all-sites-table) renders site rows.

test_7_regression_endpoints.details: GET /api/master-admin/organizations returns 200 with organizations[]. GET /api/master-admin/integrations-hub returns 200 with integrations[]. Pulse admin integrations-hub returns brand='pulse'.

critical_code_review_comments: SidebarConfig.js correctly defines 'all-sites' sub-tab under 'organizations' group (line 64)
AdminAllSites.js correctly fetches /api/master-admin/all-sites and renders totals, filters, table
AdminAllSites.js row click correctly pushes URL params (section=organizations, expand=ORG_ID, view=sites) and dispatches gymaxis:set-section event
AdminOrganizations.js correctly reads ?expand=ORG&view=VIEW from URL on mount (lines 457-465)
Backend all_sites_across_orgs endpoint correctly applies Pulse scope via is_pulse_only() and brand_filter_clause()
